integrity: The theorem follows from a proof for all positive integer dimensions, not finite enumeration. The accompanying standard-library checker is diagnostic only. No independent scientific verification is claimed.
limitations: Real scalar field only; does not classify all maximizing cliques or establish a complex analogue. An unindexed exact predecessor, especially in a partially inaccessible survey chapter, remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact clique number of the mutual Birkhoff–James orthograph of real \(\ell_\infty^n\)
